notes.title: Sleight of Hand - Dynasty Update 1.0.10.5
notes.content:
[h1]SOH - Dynasty update 1.0.10.5 is now live[/h1]

The v1.0.10.5 update addresses several issues that were reported by the community, as well as introducing the How to Play / Tutorial section available from the main menu.

[b]Update 1.0.10.5 details:[/b]

Added How to Play / Tutorial section into main menu

Fixes:

Fixed game crashing on several system after round is complete
Fixed UI sometimes becoming unresponsive
Fixed AI opponent would not complete turn sometimes
Fixed Steam Achievements would not properly unlock sometimes

Optimized game performance on low end machines


Thank you!
Evil Bunneh Team.

notes.title: Game Name Change
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512118/faabf116ff17b65e63b417eb0e1e501f9fd362f5.png[/img]

Hello everybody!

We are here to announce that we are officially changing the game's name to Sleight of Hand: Dynasty.

We had several reports and questions regarding the name and if the game associated with another game with similar title. After discussing this internally we have decided to change the name to avoid any confusion.

Please note that this change will not reflect on the game content and gameplay.


Thank you,
Evil Bunneh team.
